observed_source_limits.finding: Bootstrap logs contain an endpoint name and requested port; registration returns endpoint_id but this helper does not log that returned ID. Peers derive discovery name from task zero current attempt. A predicted name or local bootstrap log is insufficient to identify an actual successful registration.

The inspected projection supports registration replacement, explicit removal, job removal, lease expiration and federation replacement. Reads hide expired rows before sweep. A later absent endpoint cannot alone prove the application unregister hook ran, or establish when the coordinator stopped.

required_independent_records.origin: Build artifact and worker deployment metadata, independently compared with preflight bytes; declarations alone insufficient.
Actual deployed controller identity and revision evidence; candidate client Git hash must not substitute.
Independent scheduler/controller attempt records. Preserve every retry/preemption; no joining solely by task index.
Independent ONLINE run state and four diagnostic history records per rank, checked against worker declaration and exact attempt; local finish return alone insufficient.
Independent actual registry registration evidence captured during the future authorized attempt, not inferred from source naming.
Independent retained lifecycle record distinguishing explicit unregister, expiry, replacement and job/federation cleanup. Absence in a final snapshot is inconclusive about reason.
Per-attempt exclusive events and finalization traces, retained externally before local storage disposal; sequence/monotonic ordering only within each process.

collection_rules: No collector is executed or authorized by this contract. It applies only to new explicitly authorized CPU attempts; all historical terminal no-read rules remain.
Preserve raw responses with request scope, acquisition time and SHA256. Normalize separate copies with explicit provenance references; never overwrite earlier observations.

Design acquisition before submission because endpoint projection is mutable and final snapshots lose lifecycle causes. Determine whether deployed APIs already retain event evidence; local source subscriptions are not proof of an available durable remote audit API.
Do not add registry calls, proxies or synchronization barriers to the candidate runtime to manufacture evidence. A separate approved observer must have a specified acquisition method and permissions.
A source/client version match, nonzero exit, all-rank local receipts or native finished states cannot substitute for another evidence family.
If required coordinator or controller evidence is unavailable, mark the corresponding qualification INCONCLUSIVE, preserving observed task outcomes. Do not change historical classifications.
Do not infer cross-host ordering from unsynchronized wall clocks or compare monotonic clocks across processes. Use protocol boundaries and controller event ordering where supported.

Inspected EndpointService ListEndpoints omits attempt UID/number, registration/lease timestamps and deletion reasons; a successful idempotent unregister response is not proof that a live row was removed. Registration timestamps are renewed-upsert times, not necessarily first registration. Preserve these distinctions in any future collector.
unresolved: Actual registry event retention and removal-reason acquisition
